model_annotations.Bulgarian: Диаграмата илюстрира зависимостта между перплекситета и степента на разреденост (sparsity rate) за два метода – Per-Output и Per-Layer – като измерваните стойности са представени чрез стълбовидна диаграма. По хоризонталната ос са показани стойностите на разредеността, означени като проценти от 10% до 80% с интервал от 10%, а по вертикалната ос е изобразен перплекситетът, измерен в логаритмична скала от 10¹ до 10³. За всяка стойност на разредеността са представени два стълба – син със съответстващ етикет „Per-Output“ и оранжев с етикет „Per-Layer“, които показват съответните стойности на перплекситета. Стълбовете са групирани по всеки процентен ниво на разреденост, като във всяка група синият стълб е поставен преди оранжевия. Визуално се наблюдава, че перплекситетът расте с увеличаване на разредеността, като във всички случаи стойностите за Per-Layer са по-високи от тези за Per-Output, особено при разреденост над 60%, където разликата става значителна.
model_annotations.Chinese: The bar chart illustrates the complexity of two different computational measures, "Per-Output" and "Per-Layer," as a function of sparsity rate, with values plotted on a logarithmic scale ranging from $10^1$ to $10^3$. The horizontal axis represents the sparsity rate, with categories labeled from 10% to 80% in 10% increments, and is ordered sequentially. The vertical axis, labeled "Perplexity," uses a logarithmic scale with major tick marks at $10^1$, $10^2$, and $10^3$. Each sparsity rate category contains two adjacent bars: a blue bar representing "Per-Output" and an orange bar representing "Per-Layer," as indicated by the legend in the top-left corner. For sparsity rates from 10% to 50%, both measures show low complexity, with values around $10^1$ or slightly below. At 60% sparsity, the complexity increases, with "Per-Output" at approximately $10^1$ and "Per-Layer" at approximately $10^1.5$. At 70% sparsity, the complexity further increases, with "Per-Output" at approximately $10^1.5$ and "Per-Layer" at approximately $10^2$. At 80% sparsity, both measures reach their highest values, with "Per-Output" at approximately $10^2.5$ and "Per-Layer" at approximately $10^3$, making it the tallest bar in the chart. The bars are grouped by sparsity rate, with the "Per-Output" and "Per-Layer" bars displayed side-by-side within each group, and the chart shows a clear increasing trend in complexity for both measures as the sparsity rate increases.
model_annotations.English: The bar chart illustrates the relationship between perplexity and sparsity rate for two different methods: Per-Output (blue bars) and Per-Layer (orange bars). The x-axis represents the sparsity rate, ranging from 10% to 80% in 10% increments, while the y-axis shows perplexity on a logarithmic scale, spanning from 10^1 to 10^3. For each sparsity rate, two bars are displayed side-by-side, with the Per-Output method consistently showing lower perplexity than the Per-Layer method. As the sparsity rate increases, the perplexity for both methods generally increases, with the most significant change occurring between 70% and 80% sparsity. At 80% sparsity, the Per-Output perplexity is approximately 300, while the Per-Layer perplexity is around 400. The chart includes a legend in the top-left corner, clearly labeling the two methods.
model_annotations.German: Das Balkendiagramm zeigt die Beziehung zwischen der Sparsitätsrate und der Komplexität für zwei verschiedene Berechnungsansätze, „Per-Output“ und „Per-Layer“, wobei die Komplexität auf einer logarithmischen Skala dargestellt ist. Die horizontale Achse repräsentiert die Sparsitätsrate in Schritten von 10% von 10% bis 80%, wobei die Kategorien in aufsteigender Reihenfolge angeordnet sind. Die vertikale Achse, beschriftet mit „Perplexity“, verwendet eine logarithmische Skala mit Werten von 10¹ bis 10³. Für jede Sparsitätsrate sind zwei Balken dargestellt: ein blauer Balken für „Per-Output“ und ein orangefarbener Balken für „Per-Layer“. Die Balken sind gruppiert, wobei die beiden Balken für jede Sparsitätsrate nebeneinander angeordnet sind. Die Höhe der Balken variiert mit der Sparsitätsrate, wobei die Komplexität für beide Ansätze mit steigender Sparsitätsrate zunimmt. Für Sparsitätsraten von 10% bis 50% sind die Balken relativ niedrig, während sich die Balkenhöhen ab 60% deutlich erhöhen. Der höchste Balken ist der orangefarbene „Per-Layer“-Balken bei 80% Sparsitätsrate, der eine Komplexität von etwa 10³ erreicht, gefolgt vom blauen „Per-Output“-Balken bei derselben Rate, der eine Komplexität von etwa 500 aufweist. Die Balken sind nicht hervorgehoben, und die Legende befindet sich oben links im Diagramm.
